reviews.comment:
Tardaron medio año para atenderme, no me dieron bien el cambio, me robaron 50 pesos y el lugar es re chico, en vez de poner para comer afuera hubieran hecho el lugar más grande. Un señor había pedido para llevar y se lo dieron para consumir en el lugar, lo único bueno es la comida y que los que atienden son buena onda.
SE TARDARON MÁS DE 30 MINUTOS EN DAR UN CAFÉ CON LECHE

(Translated by Google)
It took them six months to serve me, they didn't give me the right change, they stole 50 pesos from me, and the place is tiny. Instead of having an outdoor seating area, they should have made the place bigger. A man had ordered takeout and they gave it to him to eat in. The only good thing is the food and that the staff are friendly.
THEY TOOK MORE THAN 30 MINUTES TO SERVE A COFFEE WITH MILK
